### Problem
`DSL` at `dsl.go:104` calls `lower := toUnicodeLower(prompt)` and then passes `lower` to all pattern branches **except** `unicodePatterns`:

```go
// line 104
lower := toUnicodeLower(prompt)

// lines 106-126: fusion, formatting, local — all use lower
for _, re := range fusionPatterns {
    if re.MatchString(lower) {  // ← uses lower
        return RouteFusion, true
    }
}

// lines 130-136: unicodePatterns — uses raw prompt
for _, re := range unicodePatterns {
    if re.MatchString(prompt) {  // ← uses raw prompt, NOT lower
        return RouteLocal, true
    }
}
```

The inconsistency is not a functional bug (Unicode character classes `\p{Han}`, `\p{Arabic}` have no case variations, so case-insensitive matching is a no-op on them). However, it is misleading: a future contributor adding a new Unicode pattern might reasonably assume `lower` is used consistently, and if they added an ASCII-range Unicode category (e.g. Latin Extended) it would be silently treated differently than the other branches.

### Proposed solution
Add a godoc comment to `DSL` explicitly documenting that `unicodePatterns` intentionally operates on the raw prompt because Unicode property escapes are case-invariant. The current code is correct; it just needs a comment explaining why the asymmetry exists.

- [ ] `make test-race` passes

264: 	cases := []struct {

276: 		// "unit test" is not followed by space/end in "unit tests"
277: 		{"multi-word phrase no match", "generate unit tests", "unit test", false},
278: 		{"multi-word phrase exact", "write unit test here", "unit test", true},
279: 		{"empty keyword", "anything", "", true},

281: 		{"test inside contest", "contest app", "test", false},
282: 		{"test inside detest", "detest this", "test", false},
283: 		{"test inside subtest", "subtest function", "test", false},
284: 		{"debug inside refactor", "refactoring needed", "debug", false},
285: 		// "css" in "css3" has no boundary after (digit follows), so false
286: 		{"css inside css3 no boundary", "css3 styling", "css", false},
287: 		// "css" in "scss" has boundary after (space follows)
288: 		{"css inside scss", "scss styles", "css", false},
289: 		// "styling" in "css3 styling" has proper boundaries
290: 		{"styling in css3 styling", "css3 styling for header", "styling", true},

294: 		{"unit-test exact", "unit-test the code", "unit-test", true},

296: 		{"integration-test in integration-testing", "integration-testing setup", "integration-test", false},
297: 		// Non-ASCII (issue #587)

305: 		{"test in test the css", "test the css", "test", true},
